name: ncit-demo
description: NCIT workshop — Serverless on AWS (students API, CSV analyzer, image OCR, scaling demo)

scripts.load:fire: aws --profile personal lambda invoke --function-name ncit-demo-load-producer --payload '{"count":10000}'  --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out /tmp/load.json && cat /tmp/load.json
scripts.load:fire:big: aws --profile personal lambda invoke --function-name ncit-demo-load-producer --payload '{"count":100000}' --cli-binary-format raw-in-base64-out /tmp/load.json && cat /tmp/load.json
scripts.queue:depth: aws --profile personal sqs get-queue-attributes --queue-url $(aws --profile personal sqs get-queue-url --queue-name ncit-demo-load-queue --query QueueUrl --output text) --attribute-names ApproximateNumberOfMessages
scripts.queue:dlq-depth: aws --profile personal sqs get-queue-attributes --queue-url $(aws --profile personal sqs get-queue-url --queue-name ncit-demo-load-dlq   --query QueueUrl --output text) --attribute-names ApproximateNumberOfMessages
scripts.queue:purge: aws --profile personal sqs purge-queue --queue-url $(aws --profile personal sqs get-queue-url --queue-name ncit-demo-load-queue --query QueueUrl --output text)
scripts.queue:purge-dlq: aws --profile personal sqs purge-queue --queue-url $(aws --profile personal sqs get-queue-url --queue-name ncit-demo-load-dlq   --query QueueUrl --output text)
